title: 同一片阳光，轮流的座位
Taking turns in the sun
brief: “我总以为庭院里那片阳光只属于一只猫。帮我分别记下庭院猫2上午晒太阳、庭院猫3下午晒太阳，再回来聊聊。不用招呼它们，也不用喂食；没有期限。”

“I thought that sunny corner in the courtyard belonged to one cat. Record courtyard cat 2 sunning in the morning and courtyard cat 3 sunning in the afternoon, then tell me. No calling, feeding, or deadline.”
page: 我把两次观察讲给Dani Costa听：庭院猫2上午晒太阳，庭院猫3下午晒太阳。Dani笑了：“原来不是一只猫守着座位，是两只猫各有自己的时候。”我们给这个小角落留了名字：轮流的阳光。

I told Dani Costa about two visits: courtyard cat 2 sunning in the morning, courtyard cat 3 in the afternoon. Dani smiled. “One cat isn't guarding the seat. Each has its own time.” We named that little corner: taking turns in the sun.
